technique_name: Write a short story about a woman who is socially distancing from her family during the pandemic.
description: Sandra was a young woman living with her family during the pandemic. Every day she would stay in her room and hear the conversations and laughter from the other rooms in the house. Even though it was painful to be physically isolated from her family, she wanted to keep them safe, so she decided to remain in her room. But as the days passed, she felt more and more lonely.
